svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Vibration fault signatures in the spectrum
svg.desc: Six idealised spectra with frequency in orders of shaft speed. Healthy: small peaks at 1x and 2x. Imbalance: one tall 1x peak. Misalignment: a 2x peak taller than 1x, with 3x. Mechanical looseness: a long row of harmonics with half orders between them. Outer-race bearing defect, in the envelope spectrum: peaks at BPFO, about 3.6x for this bearing, and its harmonics, which do not fall on whole orders. Gear wear: a peak at the gear mesh frequency, teeth times shaft speed, with sidebands spaced at the shaft speed.
svg.text: Where common machine faults show up in a vibration spectrum
Idealised spectra. Frequency in orders: 1× is the shaft speed, 2× twice the shaft speed. Orange marks the fault's signature.
Low 1× and 2×; nothing else stands out
High 2× (often above 1×), strong in the axial direction
A long row of harmonics, often with half orders between
Lines at BPFO and its harmonics, between the whole orders
GMF = number of teeth × shaft speed; sidebands at the gear's 1×
Frequency around the gear mesh frequency
